title: Dementia care
summary: Care for people living with dementia: knowing the person, communication, distress, consent and keeping them safe at home.
whenToUse: Every six months, or when the service supports more people living with dementia.

statements.focus: Life history and what matters to the person in the care plan, and carers who know it.
How carers communicate and support people who are confused or distressed.
Capacity and best-interest decisions for people living with dementia.
Dementia training for carers, and care that follows current good practice.
Risks such as wandering, cooking safety and medicines, balanced with independence.
Familiar carers and routines that help the person feel safe.
